items.headline: Huspy invests $86m in Italy, acquires Integra Finance to enter market
items.summary: Huspy, the UAE-founded real estate and mortgage platform, announced an $86 million investment in Italy alongside its acquisition of Integra Finance, marking Huspy's launch in the Italian market. The deal advances Huspy's stated ambition to build an AI operating system for real estate and mortgage brokers across the Middle East and Europe.
items.why_it_matters: The acquisition shows a Gulf-backed fintech using M&A to buy distribution into a new European market rather than build it organically, a route other regional platforms may follow as they expand beyond the Middle East.

items.headline: Incredible Holdings files for judicial management after CAD/MAS probe disclosure
items.summary: Singapore-listed Incredible Holdings has filed an application for judicial management, triggering an automatic moratorium that took effect on Monday and runs until the court rules. The filing follows the company's earlier disclosure that an independent director is assisting the Commercial Affairs Department and the Monetary Authority of Singapore in a probe into its affairs.
items.why_it_matters: A judicial-management filing arriving so soon after a CAD/MAS probe disclosure points to acute financial and governance stress, a situation Singapore credit and distressed-situations investors will want on their watchlist.

items.headline: EQT opens Abu Dhabi office to launch dedicated Middle East platform
items.summary: EQT has launched a Middle East platform and opened an office in Abu Dhabi.
items.why_it_matters: The move adds EQT to the list of global sponsors building direct, on-the-ground platforms in the Gulf as they compete for regional capital and deal flow.
